name: Plugins UI
description: In this conversation, instructions are given to integrate global settings plugin operations into an API client and create a Vue.js plugins editor. First, the API client's methods for plugin interaction are updated. Next, a Vue.js component is built to list, create, and delete plugins using these methods. The component employs Vue's data, methods, and lifecycle hooks for effective state management. TailwindCSS and DaisyUI are used for styling within the existing project framework.
